latHint: Think the weapon David used against Goliath.
pivHint: David urges us to CAST our cares on the Lord. A broken arm in a CAST is often held up by a ______.
winText: You found it. CAST isn't just what we do with our cares. A broken arm in a CAST rests in a SLING.
lossText: The word was SLING. CAST was the pivot. A CAST is the hard shell that protects a broken arm, and the arm is usually held up in a SLING.
votdVerse: Cast your cares on the Lord and he will sustain you; he will never let the righteous be shaken.
passageText: Cast your cares on the Lord and he will sustain you; he will never let the righteous be shaken. But you, God, will bring down the wicked into the pit of decay; the bloodthirsty and deceitful will not live out half their days. But as for me, I trust in you.
